prior_blocking_objection_results.prior_issue: Recovery still uses external systemd-run/direct spawn and reports daemon_tracked_restored=0; daemon-owned spawn/adoption remains unresolved.
prior_blocking_objection_results.verification_method: Static inspection of /root/bin/happy-session-recovery.sh restore flow and daemon control server spawn path, plus grep for removed external-spawn strings.
evidence: /root/bin/happy-session-recovery.sh:1094-1107 builds JSON with resumeSessionId and POSTs to http://127.0.0.1:$port/spawn-session instead of systemd-run/direct node spawn.
/root/bin/happy-session-recovery.sh:1124-1128 returns failure when daemon spawn response is non-200, success=false, or has no sessionId.
/root/bin/happy-session-recovery.sh:1130-1153 POSTs /list and refuses to count the restore unless children[].happySessionId contains the returned session.
/root/bin/happy-session-recovery.sh:1427-1438 increments daemon_tracked_restored only on daemon_spawn_session success and leaves external_restored=0.
packages/happy-cli/src/daemon/controlServer.ts:215-246 accepts resumeSessionId on /spawn-session and forwards it into spawnSession.

packages/happy-cli/src/daemon/run.ts:465-479 passes resumeSessionId to the daemon-owned child as --resume, and spawnTrackedHappyProcess registers the child in pidToTrackedSession at run.ts:527-535 before waiting for the webhook.

grep found no systemd-run, Externally spawned, non-daemon-tracked, external_restored=[1-9], or --recover-session legacy restore strings in /root/bin/happy-session-recovery.sh or packages/happy-cli/src/daemon/run.ts.

prior_blocking_objection_results.prior_issue: Tombstone support exists, but manual stop/archive workflows are not wired to create tombstones, so user intent is not durably recorded by normal actions.
prior_blocking_objection_results.verification_method: Static inspection of tombstone writer and the manual stop/archive lifecycle entry points, plus grep for tombstone producers.
evidence: packages/happy-cli/src/daemon/controlClient.ts:62-91 defines recordSessionRecoveryTombstone(), deduplicates IDs, writes <id>	<timestamp>	<reason> to configuration.happyHomeDir/session_recovery_tombstones.tsv (or HAPPY_RECOVERY_TOMBSTONE_FILE), and atomically renames the temp file.
packages/happy-cli/src/daemon/run.ts:600-621 records resumeSessionId, claudeSessionId, codexThreadId, and happySessionId with reason manual-stop before sending SIGTERM/deleting tracking.
packages/happy-cli/src/claude/runClaude.ts:445-455 records resumeSessionId, current Claude sessionId, and Happy sessionId with reason manual-archive before lifecycleState=archived.
packages/happy-cli/src/codex/runCodex.ts:413-424 records resumeThreadId, current Codex threadId, and Happy sessionId with reason manual-archive before lifecycleState=archived.

packages/happy-app/sources/hooks/useSessionQuickActions.ts:172-180 and packages/happy-app/sources/sync/ops.ts:490-497 show app archive flows call the session killSession RPC, which is handled by the Claude/Codex cleanup paths above.
/root/bin/happy-session-recovery.sh:821-835 and 1323-1334 filter tombstoned saved sessions before restore, with an additional per-session guard at 1363-1366.

acceptance_results.verification_method: Static control-flow inspection and legacy-string grep.
acceptance_results.evidence: Recovery posts to daemon /spawn-session, verifies /list contains the returned happySessionId, increments daemon_tracked_restored only after that proof, and grep found no legacy external restore path strings.

acceptance_results.criterion: Manual stop/archive paths create durable tombstones that recovery respects.
acceptance_results.verification_method: Static inspection of manual stop, Claude archive, Codex archive, app archive RPC path, and recovery tombstone filter.
acceptance_results.evidence: Manual stop and archive paths call recordSessionRecoveryTombstone() before termination/archive state changes; recovery filters tombstones before attempting daemon-owned restore.
